summary.text: Rochelle Nguyen is a Democratic member of the Nevada Senate, representing District 3 in Clark County. She was appointed to the Senate in December 2022 after serving in the Nevada Assembly from 2019, and the legislature lists her as an attorney.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Nguyen was born in Vancouver, Washington, in 1977 and earned a B.A. in sociology from the University of Puget Sound in 1999 and a J.D. from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, Boyd School of Law in 2002.
She was appointed to the Assembly in December 2018 and served there until 2022, chairing the Health and Human Services Committee in the 2021 session.
She sits on the Senate Jobs and Economy Committee.
